title: Show the text the task needs
statement: Whenever a task, prompt or feedback asks a student to find or cite evidence or sends them back to the text, keep the text on screen.
detail: An outside review of a course found prompts asking students to cite the text while the passage was hidden, so they were told to look back at a text that was gone (`grade3-reading/artifacts/op-taxonomy-calibration-2026-07-10/r2-feedback-docx-converted.txt`). A walkthrough of a later course found the transfer items of most lessons shown beside the wrong pinned passage, with the open-response marker handed that same wrong text (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-course/ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW-2026-08-19-R2.md`), and an earlier review found a pinned excerpt that held only the lines of wrong answers (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-course/ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW-2026-08-19.md`). The text sits beside the live question and steps, showing the part that holds the evidence.
against: What stays in view is what has been read: the project's engine offers back only the earlier parts of a story on a passage page, never a later one (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0180-lesson-structure-procedure-rulings.qmd`, lines 61-62); and a film is a different case, where few words on screen help (see the record on few words on screen).
